final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, o.dealedge AS dealedge, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avgdiff, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.dealedge), s2 AS (SELECT dealedge, AVG(avgdiff) AS avgavg FROM s1 GROUP BY dealedge) SELECT s1.orderslink, s1.dealedge, s1.avgdiff, s1.cnt, s1.avgdiff - s2.avgavg AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s1.dealedge = s2.dealedge WHERE s1.avgdiff > s2.avgavg ORDER BY (s1.avgdiff - s2.avgavg) IS NULL, diff DESC LIMIT 10
